capabilities: Read the local browser history database file
Create or update a history note per day
Set the history database path and note file name format
Sync manually, on startup, or on a timed interval
Verify database access with a connection check
extras: README warns not to publish the history notes because URLs may contain authentication information, and notes that antivirus software may flag the plugin as suspicious (a false positive, since it only reads the browser history database file).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture what you browsed each day, so browsing activity is lost instead of being logged alongside your notes.

requires.name: : a web browser whose history database the plugin reads

summary: Plugin that imports your browser's history database into daily Markdown notes, with manual, startup, and interval-based syncing.
